current.text: Karim Lopez is a rookie. He was the 21st pick and went to Memphis with Isaiah Stewart in a trade for pick 17.
The October team preview does not list him among the projected Memphis starters (Jerome, Coward, Grant, Boozer, Edey) or the projected bench (Pippen, Wells, Stewart, GG Jackson, Spencer).
The Memphis roster is overcrowded, mostly at forward, and more cuts are still needed.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo is expected to use an 11 or 12 man rotation. Only Cameron Boozer and Cedric Coward are expected to top 30 minutes.
One expert thinks he probably cannot play alongside Cameron Boozer, who is projected to start. That limits his path to minutes.
His Summer League was very good but overrated. He is ranked 20th in dynasty rookie ranks, and Josh thinks Cameron Carr should probably rank ahead of him.

durable.text: Experts see a low ceiling. One calls him a solid rotation player without much upside. Another says he does not know what Lopez does well.
Experts say he cannot really shoot, defend or pass, and he is not a strong rebounder.
Coach Iisalo plays short, hard stints of about five minutes and keeps individual minutes down.

note: Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 721st. ESPN gives no price. He should not be one of the 144 players drafted in our auction. His Yahoo projection (6.7 points, 3.2 rebounds, 0.5 steals, 0.2 blocks) is below the top 250 pool in every category except turnovers, and those are low only because his usage is low, so no build needs him. Early in the season, the only thing to check is whether he makes Iisalo's 11 or 12 man rotation. Even then, the short stints would cap his counting stats.
